summary: Evaluate the selected basis as columns of a sample-by-basis design matrix.

capability: Evaluate the selected polynomial or cubic-spline basis as columns of a sample-by-basis design matrix.
operation: basis selection to sampled design matrix
basis selector, sample abscissa and constructor options -> matrix of basis values
discovery.model: Caller-selected ascending-power polynomial or C2 cubic-spline basis; construction delegates to the explicit basis factory.
discovery.geometry: One-dimensional scalar abscissa and ordinate samples; rows follow the input domain and columns follow the basis order. No multidimensional geometry is reconstructed.
discovery.boundary: Spline basis evaluation is zero outside the finite knot interval with no extrapolation; unsupported quartic and special-function selections are rejected.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to Evaluator yielding matrix of basis values
identity.definition: Evaluate selected basis functions into columns of a design matrix
identity.model: Construction delegates to the explicit source basis factory
identity.geometry: one-dimensional scalar abscissa and ordinate samples
identity.coordinates: Rows follow input domain; columns follow basis order
identity.boundary: Spline evaluation is zero outside the finite knot interval; no extrapolation is performed.
assumptions: Finite constructor samples and boundary-specific assumptions
Polynomial coefficients are ascending-power columns; poly_deg default3 means three basis functions
Spline keyword defaults n_knots=5,domain=(0,1); xdata/ydata supplied arrays must match

outputs.name: matrix
outputs.description: Evaluator yielding matrix of basis values

preconditions: Finite constructor samples and boundary-specific assumptions
Polynomial coefficients are ascending-power columns; poly_deg default3 means three basis functions
Spline keyword defaults n_knots=5,domain=(0,1); xdata/ydata supplied arrays must match
supported: Finite polynomial and spline basis selections implemented by scirel.geometry.basis
excluded: Quartic and special-function factory selections are rejected; no invented implementations
Physical special-spline closures and unsupported knot domains remain unresolved

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises KeyError for an unregistered selector, NotImplementedError for an unsupported retained selector, TypeError for an unknown keyword, and ValueError for invalid spline samples/knots/boundary parameters; linear-system failures propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Numerical linear-algebra or optional SciPy special-function exceptions propagate from evaluation.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; basis construction and evaluation are direct computations without an iterative convergence claim.
failure_semantics.partial_results: A failed constructor returns no evaluator; spline queries outside the knot interval return zero.

example.description: Evaluate the default polynomial basis on two samples and inspect the row/column order.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.geometry.basis import BasisMatrix

samples = np.array([0.0, 1.0])
matrix = BasisMatrix("poly")(samples)
np.testing.assert_allclose(matrix, [[1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]])
example.expected: The returned design matrix has shape (2, 3) and values [[1, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1]].
